introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure network configuration management system for a university that manages configuration changes across routers, switches, wireless controllers, and other network infrastructure.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: Authorized network administrators should be able to review current configurations, submit configuration changes, track change history, and restore previously approved configurations when necessary.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: The system should detect unauthorized or unexpected configuration changes, generate security alerts, maintain audit logs of configuration activity and administrator actions, and restrict administrative functions based on approved roles.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The platform should provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with existing university identity services, support multiple campus locations, and remain secure, reliable, scalable, and manageable.

open_issues: What makes a configuration change unauthorized?
Which fields must the audit logs contain?

assumptions: These are defensive planning hypotheses, not observed incidents or approved extra controls. Unrecognized threats and actual implementation effectiveness require human review.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting User identities and authenticated access: Unauthorized use of a legitimate identity could expose resources or alter system state.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: An attacker uses a compromised identity or authenticated session to impersonate an authorized user and exercise that user's permitted operations.
risks.mitigation: Review impersonation and compromised-identity paths against the stated access duties; confirm any additional identity or session protections with the stakeholder. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Role and permission boundaries: A lower-privilege user could access restricted functions or sensitive resources.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A principal exploits an incorrect role assignment or permission check to perform operations outside the source-defined authorization boundary.
risks.mitigation: Test permitted and denied role/resource pairs against the linked authorization duties; review ambiguous permission assignments with the resource owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Integration trust paths: Untrusted integration data could cause incorrect decisions or hide security events.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: A compromised connected system or integration path supplies forged, altered or missing identity, event or policy data used by the source-defined integration.
risks.mitigation: Review trust assumptions at the specified integration boundaries with missing or altered input fixtures; confirm the required failure handling with the owner. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Security and administrative audit evidence: Investigators could lose reliable evidence of the events required by the brief.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: An attacker or recording failure suppresses or alters source-required audit evidence so that access decisions, security events or admin actions cannot be reconstructed.
risks.mitigation: Compare source-required events with the resulting audit evidence; assess missing and altered-record cases and confirm unprovided protection or retention decisions. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

risks.description: Derived risk affecting Monitoring and security alerts: Relevant suspicious activity could remain undetected or receive delayed investigation.
risks.rationale: This is a planning risk linked to the defensive hypothesis: Derived hypothesis: Suspicious activity evades the source-defined detection workflow, or excessive events obscure actionable alerts before an authorized reviewer can investigate.
risks.mitigation: Evaluate the stated detection duties with representative positive and negative events; confirm undecided thresholds, alert priorities and investigation responsibilities. Assign a responsible reviewer. Verify the linked canonical obligations against their authored acceptance criteria in an authorized isolated environment. Record gaps and obtain a scope decision before adding any product behavior; preserve explicit exclusions.

(E-004) Derived integration_assurance (+8 points): Connected systems need integration verification before broader rollout; their age, technology and technical uncertainty remain unspecified. (E-004)

activities: Review and prioritize the backlog for the next iteration without changing source-defined scope.

Implement the source-defined work group: FR-001: The system shall manage configuration changes across routers, switches, wireless controllers, and other network infrastructure.; FR-002: The system shall allow Authorized network administrators to review current configurations.; FR-003: The system shall allow Authorized network administrators to submit configuration changes.; FR-004: The system shall allow Authorized network administrators to track change history.; FR-005: The system shall allow Authorized network administrators to restore previously approved configurations when necessary.; FR-006: The system shall detect unauthorized or unexpected configuration changes.; FR-007: The system shall generate security alerts.; FR-008: The system shall maintain audit logs of configuration activity and administrator actions.; FR-009: The system shall restrict administrative functions based on approved roles.; FR-010: The system shall provide a centralized dashboard.; FR-011: The system shall integrate with existing university identity services.; FR-012: The system shall support multiple campus locations.

Implement the source-defined work group: NFR-001: The system shall be secure.; NFR-002: The system shall remain secure.; NFR-003: The system shall remain reliable.; NFR-004: The system shall remain scalable.; NFR-005: The system shall remain manageable.

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-001: Given: the system manages configuration changes across routers, switches, wireless controllers, and other network infrastructure When: the system initiates a configuration change operation Expected: the resulting configuration is applied without error to the targeted device

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-002: Given: Authorized network administrators review current configurations When: initiate the review of current configurations Expected: the requested configuration items are returned for examination

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-003: Given: Authorized network administrators submit a configuration change When: initiate submission of a configuration change on the named object Expected: the object's resulting policy, job, submitted change, or history is observed as updated

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-004: Given: Authorized network administrators track change history When: initiate tracking of change history on the named object Expected: the object's resulting policy, job, submitted change, or history is observed as accessible and accurate

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-005: Given: Authorized network administrators restore previously approved configurations When: initiate restoration of a previously approved configuration on the named object Expected: the object's resulting policy, job, submitted change, or restored state is observed as valid and consistent with approval records

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-006: Given: the system detects an unauthorized or unexpected configuration change When: the system initiates the detection process Expected: an alert is generated and logged in the audit trail

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-007: Given: a security alert condition is triggered by an anomalous configuration event When: the system evaluates and responds to the alert condition Expected: the alert exists in the designated monitoring channel as captured externally

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-008: Given: an administrator modifies a network configuration When: the system records the action and all associated metadata Expected: The system records the action and all associated metadata.

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-009: Given: an administrator attempts to perform a restricted administrative function When: the system evaluates the role-based access policy Expected: the request is denied if the role lacks approved permissions

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-010: Given: system provides a centralized dashboard When: the system initiates the display of network configuration data Expected: The system initiates the display of network configuration data and the external test capture records the resulting response.

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-011: Given: system integrates with existing university identity services When: the system performs a login authentication request via university identity protocols Expected: an authenticated session is established and persisted across operations

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-012: Given: system supports multiple campus locations When: the system is initiated from each stated campus location Expected: use succeeds at all locations with consistent configuration access

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-013: Given: A draft acceptance plan for this quality goal: the system shall be secure against unauthorized access and data exfiltration via network interfaces. When: An analyst inspects or reviews that acceptance plan to determine whether measurable targets are defined or remain TBD. Expected: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed, as no specific thresholds, attack scenarios, or response metrics are stated in the draft plan.

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-014: Given: The system shall remain secure under all operational conditions. When: An analyst reviews the security assurance plan and evaluates whether it includes measurable targets for threat detection, response time, and configuration drift Expected: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-015: Given: The system shall remain reliable under all operational conditions. When: An analyst reviews the reliability assurance plan and evaluates whether it includes measurable targets for failure detection, recovery time, and service uptime Expected: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-016: Given: The system shall remain scalable under all operational conditions. When: An analyst reviews the scalability assurance plan and evaluates whether it includes measurable targets for throughput, latency, and resource utilization growth Expected: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed

In an authorized isolated test environment, execute TEST-017: Given: The system shall remain manageable under all operational conditions. When: An analyst reviews the manageability assurance plan and evaluates whether it includes measurable targets for configuration change frequency, audit coverage, and Expected: The plan's measurable targets remain TBD or unconfirmed
